what: Anaheim slice (1.2 km box) round our own sports bar's spot on South Claudina Way, for the on-foot mode: streets, footways, buildings, land use, water, infrastructure.
attribution: Overture Maps Foundation (release 2026-09-23.1). Streets, connectors, buildings, land use, water and infrastructure derived from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0; a few street records also list TomTom, under ODbL 1.0); some buildings from Microsoft ML Buildings (ODbL 1.0); building heights partly from USGS 3DEP lidar (US public domain); venue point from Overture places (CDLA Permissive 2.0); land cover from ESA WorldCover (CC BY 4.0).
units: decimetres; x east, z south (game coordinates); each geometry delta-coded, first point absolute

venue.note: Our own fictional sports bar. The spot was located in Overture places (see tools/anaheim/README.md); no real name, logo, sign, menu or trade dress is used.

keys.seg: c class (dict.seg; rail as "rail:<class>"), s subclass (dict.sub), n street name (dict.name), r route, p points, k [vertex, connector index into conn, ...], sp max speed mph, w width m, ow one-way (1 along p, -1 against), nf foot denied, lv OSM level (int, or [[from,to,level]] as fractions of the piece), br/tn/lk/cv/uc bridge/tunnel/link/covered/under-construction (1 = whole, else [[from,to]]), sf surface (dict.surf)
keys.bld: p outer ring (counter-clockwise in x,z), hl holes, h height m, mh min height m, f floors, c class (dict.bcls), t subtype (dict.btype), r roof shape (dict.roof), ug underground, lid 1 when Overture took the height from USGS lidar
keys.bpart: building parts: b index into bld, p, h, mh, r, rh roof height
keys.venue: x, z metres; bld index of the venue's building (the one the point stands in, else the nearest); lot index into infra of its mapped parking area, null when none is mapped at the building; site: bld_how contains|nearest, bld_m metres from the point, bld_area_m2, bld_h, bld_places other open place records inside the footprint (it is shared), nearest_mapped_parking {infra, m_from_bld}, lot_how mapped|derived (derived: no parking area is mapped there; the open ground the footprint wraps round, widened 9 m along the mapped service ways that cross it, kept off the kerbs and the footprint; see tools/anaheim/build_slice.py), lot_p the lot ring (delta-coded dm, counter-clockwise), lot_area_m2, lot_aisles seg indices of the service ways in it, lot_entries conn indices where they meet a public street (directly or by a driveway up to 40 m), lot_entry_streets those streets' names
keys.licences: per Overture type: "dataset | licence" as listed in each record's sources, with record counts (fetched rows, before clipping)
keys.landuse/water/infra/cover: c class (dict.lu / dict.water / dict.infra "subtype:class" / dict.cover), p polygon ring (+hl) or l line
keys.infra_pts: flat [class (dict.infra), x, z, ...] for point features (crossings, signals, stops, benches, lamps...)
